step_by_step_reasoning: The whiteboard shows a multi-tenant event integration architecture for Capillary. Starting from the bottom left actor icon (configurers/developers), an arrow connects to an ALB, which routes to a Kubernetes cluster (K8S) on EC2, persisting metadata into DynamoDB. On the top left actor icon (third-party systems), an arrow connects to API Gateway, which invokes a Webhook Lambda. The Webhook Lambda reads metadata from DynamoDB and pushes events into an SQS queue. A Processor Lambda consumes messages from SQS, writing analytics to DynamoDB and streaming processing events into Kinesis Data Streams, which are finally consumed by Workers running on EC2.
